title: PySRRiceMethane: symbolic regression pipeline and results for rice-paddy CH4 flux equations across three Asian sites
description: Analysis code, derived data tables and results for the paper 'Symbolic Regression Reveals Site-specific Functional Forms of Methane Flux Across Three Asian Rice Paddies Under Contrasting Water Management'. Pipeline: GAM-RF feature selection with VIF filtering, PySR symbolic regression under twelve seeds with two pre-declared selection criteria, day-grouped cross-validation with a coefficient-stability screen, RF/NN benchmarks, Sobol sensitivity, and leave-one-site-out validation of the pooled equation. The raw IRRI 2016 eddy-covariance record is available on reasonable request and is not part of this deposit; its derived analysis tables are included with the co-authors' agreement. Mase and Cheorwon derived tables originate from the FLUXNET-CH4 community product (CC-BY-4.0).
